The '''Proving Grounds''' was an old ritual site on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] to revere battle.<ref name="Codex" />

Originally built by [[Naddist|cultists]] affiliated with [[Freedon Nadd]], the location was used to host competitions where competitors would fight to the death for the favor of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]]. Eventually, the site was seized from the Sith by the [[Untamed]], who were not deterred by the presence of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] on the proving grounds. The Untamed used the site to host trials for [[Beast Riders]] interested in becoming [[Beast-Lord]]s. Due to Untamed Beast-Lord [[Akoru]]'s neglect of the site, the planet's noble families also used the site as a vacation retreat. Oftentimes, nobles returned from the retreat with claims to have accomplished noble feats, but very little evidence supported these statements.<ref name="Codex" />
